metaDescription: Shop custom recycled clipboards for eco-friendly bulk orders. Perfect for offices and events. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Custom recycled clipboards combine durability with environmental responsibility, making them a smart choice for businesses aiming to reduce waste. Made from post-consumer recycled materials, these clipboards offer the same sturdy writing surface as traditional options while supporting sustainability goals. Ideal for safety managers equipping field teams or HR directors assembling eco-conscious welcome kits, they can be imprinted with your logo using screen printing or pad printing. Choose from standard letter size or legal size to fit your documents.
heroAltText: Custom recycled clipboards with logo imprint, made from post-consumer recycled materials, stacked on a desk
